description_en: Lists the mappings between identities and benefit packages. Use this API to retrieve the benefit packages bound to a user
description_zh: 列举实体和权益包关联，可用于获取用户绑定的权益包列表
kebab_example: aliyun pds list-identity-to-benefit-pkg-mapping --identity-type user --identity-id user123 --include-expired false --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity. To manage benefits for a user, set this parameter to `user`
parameters.help_zh:
实体的类型
管理用户权益，传user
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the identity.

When managing benefits for a user, specify the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
实体的唯一标识

管理用户权益时，传user_id
parameters.name: identity_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return expired benefit packages. The default value is `false`
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回已经超期的权益包，默认为false
parameters.name: include_expired
